scope: Phase 2 Job Management implementation; source complete, database migration and private beta release pending approval

checks.coverage: Eight SQL-backed execution scenarios and the paginated Unicode PDF renderer. Actual linked-appointment lifecycle trigger included. Covers three-visit job, deposit, approved addition, time/expense costing, completion, one final invoice across retries, assigned-only RPC/table/file access, pause/revocation, optimistic visits/rates, calendar view and legacy same-time repair.

checks.note: Ran when the execution suite contained five cases; final execution suite separately passed all eight.
Default parallel settings invocation failed whole files under memory pressure; all 116 passed at concurrency one.

checks.command: npm run assessment:sync && npm run assessment:test && npm run assessment:check

visual.pdf: Rendered and visually inspected the synthetic one-page completion report. Long text/checklist/Unicode/photo pagination passed the renderer check.
visual.browser: The shared browser initially could not reach the managed preview and subsequently rejected observation of its browser error page. No workaround was used. New UI journeys passed JSDOM; authenticated browser, physical iPhone/camera/file upload and provider acceptance are not certified.

database.reason: First native apply request expired; second was canceled. Read-only follow-up confirmed visit column, field RPC and completion-report RPC all absent. No alternate DDL route was used.
database.live_rollback_workflow: Not performed for Phase 2 because migrations did not apply.

cost.note: Reuses current Supabase storage/upload quotas and existing PDF dependencies. Pro five total account seats and separate worker-profile limits retained. Hosting, database, storage and bandwidth remain subject to existing usage charges.

limits: Source/SQL/DOM/PDF checks are not live-provider, authenticated browser, physical-device or measured-load certification.
Completion acknowledgement is typed in person on the business device; remote signing, offline synchronization, GPS routing, inventory and ERP integrations are outside this phase.
Current beta branch/domain remain on their prior release until the three migrations can be applied and rollback-verified.
